draft.subject: The time you spend writing notes
draft.body:
Fatima,

Most clinicians we talk to spend 90–120 minutes a day on documentation. Not because the notes are complicated — because the systems are.

JotPsych writes structured notes from your session recording, checks them against 150+ payer rules, and surfaces the right codes. The documentation still happens. It just doesn't take your evening.

It works with whatever EHR you're using now. No migration, up in five minutes. When you're ready, it can replace the whole system.

If you want to see it again, I'll set up a 15-minute walk-through.

Marcus
JotPsych

--
